reason: The cited evidence (E1) supports SRO effects on dislocation motion, yield strength, and work hardening in CrCoNi MEAs, but it does not address FeNiCrMn, dynamic loading, strain rate sensitivity, or the ability to control SRO via annealing in this alloy. The key premises about FeNiCrMn-specific SRO control and dynamic response are unsupported.
premises: SRO inhibits dislocation activation and alters slip paths in CrCoNi MEAs
SRO increases yield strength by ~25% and doubles initial work-hardening rate in CrCoNi MEAs
SRO causes tortuous, delayed dislocation motion enhancing strain-hardening in HEAs/MEAs
SRO can be controlled in FeNiCrMn by sub-solidus annealing without changing composition or gross microstructure
SRO effects on dislocation barriers translate to increased strain rate sensitivity under dynamic loading
